description: Send feedback or report a Kourier error, attributed to your account. Requires your Kourier API key in the MCP connection's Authorization: Bearer header, never in tool arguments. Submit only what the user wants to share; exclude API keys, tokens, passwords, personal data, and private code or logs. Include a request_id when available to help investigation.

client_name.description: Optional client or harness name and version.

message.description: Feedback, or a description of the error with expected/actual behavior and reproduction steps. No secrets or private data.

request_id.description: Optional Kourier request ID associated with the error.

name: submit_feedback
title: Submit feedback or an error report
